title: Ijwi ry’ukuri ryo mu bihe vya kera
intro: Hariho umutima muri Korowani inkuru yawo ivugwa mu mirongo mikeyi gusa, yamara kamere zabo nziza zikayangana mu buryo butomoye cane. Uwo musuku wa kera w’Ikigongwe, ashimagizwa n’Ishobora vyose kubera ingeso nziza idasanzwe, afise ikibanza mu mapaji y’ivyahishuriwe. Igikorwa cawe ni ukumenya uwo mubare udasanzwe. Woba ushobora gukeka abo ari bo?
clues: Ndi umuhanuzi wa Allah yabaye mu mayaruka ya mbere y’abantu.
Allah yaramvuze mu gitabu ciwe ndi kumwe n’abandi bahanuzi, bose bashimagizwa kubera iyo ngeso nziza nyene.
Allah yarankuye mu kibanza co hejuru abandi bakeyi bashitseko.
Izina ryanje rivugwa muri Sura Al-Anbiya, ryifatanijwe n’abandi bahanuzi babiri bashimagizwa kubera ukwihangana kwabo.
Ndi Idris, umuhanuzi w’ukuri kandi ashizwe hejuru.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kuguma wihanganye kandi uvuga ukuri, hanyuma akaduzwa mu kibanza co hejuru .
Kubaka ubwato bunini bwo gukiza abizera umwuzure w'amazi ushobora gutikiza .
Kujugunywa mu muriro ururumba maze akavayo ata co akomerewe na gato .
Guhangana n’umwami w’inkomezi no gutsinda ingabo ziwe z’abapfumu .
Kurokoka mu nda y’ifi nini mu binogo vy’ikiyaga .
trial.answer: Kuguma wihanganye kandi uvuga ukuri, hanyuma ukaduzwa mu kibanza co hejuru .

location.label: Ikintu nyamukuru
options: Ikibanza co hejuru kandi gishizwe hejuru na Allah
Ubwato bunini cane bubatswe mu mbaho ​​kandi bushizweko ibiti vy’ibiti .

Ikiyaga kinini cacitsemwo inzira zumye .

location.answer: Ikibanza co hejuru kandi gishizwe hejuru na Allah

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yemerewe mu mbabazi za Allah nk'umwe mu bagororotsi .
Yakijijwe hamwe n'abizera bose umwuzure wo kw'isi yose .
Yasohotse mu rubeya atakozwe n'umuriro
Yarongoye bene Isirayeli mu mwidegemvyo bajabuka ikiyaga ata nkomanzi
Basubiye kubonana n’umuryango wabo bakundwa inyuma y’imyaka myinshi y’amagorwa .
outcome.answer: Yemerewe mu mbabazi za Allah nk'umwe mu bagororotsi .
